final: WITH timing AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS timing_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), overall AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS overall_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals) SELECT AVG(timing.timing_avg), AVG(timing.timing_avg - overall.overall_avg) FROM timing CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND timing.timing_avg > overall.overall_avg
